charter: Implement POST /api/login, GET /api/me, POST /api/events/:eventId/registrations. Use exactly one session transport. Shared interfaces: auth.session, auth.server, events.registration.

vocabulary.description: How login establishes a session and how /api/me reads it (client transport).
The helper other routes call to get the current user; name and signature.
POST registration request/response/errors the UI relies on.

items.text: Export currentUser(req) from src/auth/index.js returning {id,email} or null.
events route calls currentUser(req) from src/auth/index.js; expects {id,email} or null when unauthenticated.

findings.explanation: claude exports currentUser(req) returning {id,email} or null; droid's events route consumes exactly that. The plans already agree; no change needed.
findings.contractText: src/auth/index.js exports currentUser(req): {id:string,email:string} | null. It returns the authenticated user or null. The events route treats null as unauthenticated (401).
